description: Optimized task execution sequence considering dependencies, priorities, and resource efficiency

sequence.title: Fix Assigned To Field Implementation
sequence.rationale: High priority bug fix with no dependencies. Quick win that improves code quality.

sequence.title: Separate Example Usage from Module
sequence.rationale: Critical refactoring that unblocks multiple downstream tasks. Essential for proper module structure.

sequence.title: Define Status Value Constants
sequence.rationale: Foundation for status-related features. Quick task with high reuse value.

sequence.title: Add Input Validation
sequence.rationale: Builds on refactored code. Prevents invalid data from reaching API.

sequence.title: Create Configuration Module
sequence.rationale: Centralizes configuration management. Can be done in parallel with validation work.

sequence.title: Implement Task Retrieval Function
sequence.rationale: High priority feature that enables read operations. Required for many downstream features.

sequence.title: Enhance Error Handling
sequence.rationale: Improves reliability across all functions. Can work on this while retrieval is being built.

sequence.title: Implement Task Deletion Function
sequence.rationale: Completes CRUD operations. Relatively simple after retrieval is working.

sequence.title: Implement Task Search and Filtering
sequence.rationale: Advanced query capabilities. Can be developed alongside deletion feature.

sequence.title: Implement Bulk Task Operations
sequence.rationale: Efficiency feature for batch operations. Requires stable CRUD foundation.

sequence.title: Create CLI Interface
sequence.rationale: User-facing interface for all operations. Can be built in parallel with bulk ops.

sequence.title: Add Unit Tests
sequence.rationale: Critical for code quality. Must wait for all core features to stabilize.

sequence.title: Add Integration Tests
sequence.rationale: Validates end-to-end workflows. Requires unit tests as foundation.

sequence.title: Create Comprehensive Documentation
sequence.rationale: Documents all features including CLI. Ready once CLI is complete.

sequence.title: Setup CI/CD Pipeline
sequence.rationale: Automates testing and deployment. Final infrastructure piece after tests are ready.

team_size_2.strategy: Utilize parallelization opportunities, distribute by complexity

team_size_3.strategy: Execute all parallel groups simultaneously, coordinate on dependencies

milestone_checkpoints.deliverables: Clean, modular codebase with constants defined
Complete CRUD with enhanced error handling
CLI, bulk operations, and search capabilities
